## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and what changes for the user or contributor.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. State any untested behavior.
For transfer changes, cover recovery and real saved output where applicable.
For UI changes, attach sanitized screenshots and describe keyboard behavior.

## Scope and compatibility

Mention new permissions, dependencies, protocol limitations, durable-state changes
or third-party notices. Link the relevant plan/issue when one exists.
